condition_description: dusk/night collection: lower exposure, compressed contrast, visible read noise
note: THE NEGATIVE CONTROL FOR THE EXPLANATION MECHANISM ITSELF. An illumination change declared as a seasonal one is reported CONSISTENT, because both declarations predict movement in the colour view and that is where ~93% of the displacement lands for either. Measured, expected, and the reason the finding says consistency is not confirmation: the attribution answers 'does the declaration predict this movement', not 'which declared change occurred'.
